moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaches
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, commemorating the Gunpowder Plot, is on Thursday 5th November, with many fireworks displays scheduled for this weekend (Oct 31/Nov 1) and next weekend (Nov 7/8) across the UK.

angles.name: National Countdown
angles.copy: Only 5 days until Bonfire Night! Are you heading to a big organised display or having a smaller gathering at home? Stay safe and enjoy the sparkles!

angles.name: Local Displays
angles.copy: Planning your Bonfire Night fun? Many local displays are happening this weekend and next, including those in Wakefield, Surrey, and across London. Check local listings for details!

moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Chart Again
moments.blurb: Cardiff-born musician Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' holds the Official UK Singles Chart number one spot for a second consecutive week, making him the first Welsh act to achieve this in 15 years.

angles.name: Welsh #1 Success
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Cardiff's own Jamie Miller, still at #1 on the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Babydoll'! Two weeks at the top – what an achievement for Welsh music!

angles.name: Listen to the Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still got 'Babydoll' by Jamie Miller on repeat? The Welsh sensation is dominating the UK charts for a second week. Tune in for the biggest hits right now!
